subject: Urgent: Hosted -> Dedicated/Private decision after today's incident
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@novaretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — deployment mode needs

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Summary of needs: low single-digit 100ms latency for customer-facing generation (100–200 req/s peak), strict PII handling for checkout logs, and an internal SRE requirement for capacity isolation during peak promo windows. You mentioned yesterday's incident where the hosted pool hit throttling during a marketing flash sale — I'm sorry you had to deal with that.

- Options we discussed: Hosted API (fast to ship), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput), Private VPC (customer-managed network + KMS).

Next steps I propose: 
1) Connor to validate whether the current model/profile would require Dedicated for your peak profile and give a quick capacity estimate (ETA: 3–6 hours).
2) Rishi to prepare pricing for short-term reserved capacity and a Private VPC onboarding estimate (ETA: EOD).
3) You to share the incident log and expected peak windows so we can size appropriately (I've added an attachment request).

I'll flag this as high priority on our side given the incident. If Dedicated/Private looks like the right next step, we can accelerate onboarding and offer a temporary uplift to reduce throttling risk while the contract is finalized.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: capacity_estimate_v2.xlsx (placeholder)
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@novaretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: NovaRetail SRE <sre@novaretail.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — deployment mode needs

Marissa — appreciate the follow-up and the clear plan. Quick context from our side: 

- The incident this morning was an unexpected surge during an early-morning promo push. Our telemetry shows a spike to ~220 req/s for generative content over 10 minutes; hosted token throttling kicked in and several customer-facing flows degraded.
- We're fine with hosted for normal traffic, but the business impact from these unpredictable spikes is material. We need a predictable mitigation path ASAP.
- Compliance: we have a vendor data policy that encourages isolation for PII-heavy workloads; Privacy & Legal will want either dedicated tenancy or customer-controlled keys.

I've attached the incident log and timestamps. Can you confirm if Dedicated capacity would be an operational quick-win (i.e., we can route traffic there within 24–48 hours)? Also include ballpark cost for a 2-week reserved uplift while we finalize procurement.

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Head of Product, NovaRetail
alex.moreno@novaretail.com

Attachment: incident-log-20260610.txt (placeholder)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@novaretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 12:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — deployment mode needs

Hi all — reviewed the incident log and the traffic characteristics. Quick technical readout: 

- The observed 200–220 req/s sustained for 10 minutes + request size suggests that the hosted multi-tenant pool hit its soft limits for that model profile. 
- Short-term mitigation: Dedicated reserved pool can be provisioned and traffic routed within ~24 hours if we allocate capacity from available inventory. We can also set an automatic routing policy to DR (dedicated pool) for flagged routes during promo windows. 
- Compliance: For PII-sensitive flows, Dedicated + customer-managed KMS (available in Dedicated and Private) satisfies the Legal team; Private VPC would be necessary only if NovaRetail requires customer-owned network egress or air-gapped deployment.

I ran a quick capacity estimate (see attached capacity_estimate_v2.xlsx): to cover your peak with headroom, we'd recommend a 4-GPU reserved slab for the primary region and a 1-GPU failover in a second region for cross-region resilience. That should handle 300 req/s comfortably with latency targets.

I'm marking this as an urgent provisioning request if you want us to hold capacity while procurement completes. If so, Marissa — we'll need a short confirmation and a signed MSA addendum to start the reservation.

—Connor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com

Attachment: capacity_estimate_v2.xlsx (placeholder)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@novaretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — deployment mode needs

Alex — looping in pricing and CS for operational/contract support. Short answers: 

- Pricing: For a 2-week reserved uplift (4-GPU slab + 1-GPU failover), ballpark total is $38k for the 2-week period (includes accelerated onboarding and priority capacity). I'll send a formal short-term proposal and an MSA addendum template within the hour.
- Private VPC onboarding estimate (if you prefer): ~3–4 weeks for network & KMS setup and security review; higher ongoing cost and longer procurement lead time.
- We can do an interim arrangement: immediate Dedicated reservation + start Private VPC onboarding in parallel if you want to move to full isolation later.

Laura — can your team provide a 24–48 hour ops checklist for onboarding into Dedicated and confirm SLA/monitoring handoff?

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Attachment: (pricing_summary.pdf placeholder)
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moraretail.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — deployment mode needs

Hi team — ops checklist and timeline below for Dedicated rapid onboarding: 

1) Account & Billing signoff (Marissa/Rishi) — immediate (same day)
2) Capacity reservation (Connor) — provision within 24 hours once signed confirmation received
3) Route & DNS changes (NovaRetail SRE) — we'll provide config snippets; low-risk cutover; estimated <2 hours for a migration window
4) Monitoring & runbook handoff (Laura) — we'll run a 1-hr playbook review and provide alerting templates
5) Compliance artifacts (SOC2 excerpt attached) — provide to your Privacy team; Private VPC can follow in parallel

If NovaRetail confirms they want Redwood to hold capacity, please reply here with the single-sentence confirmation and the contact for PO. We'll treat this as an expedited onboarding track.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — deployment mode needs

All — thanks for the fast responses. NovaRetail confirms: please go ahead and reserve the 4-GPU + 1-GPU failover slab for the next two weeks. PO contact is procurement@novaretail.com; they will issue a PO within 24 hours. We'll also start the Private VPC intake in parallel and share network docs by Monday.

We appreciate the expedited support — this is mission-critical for our promo cadence. Please send the short-term invoice/PO instructions and the MSA addendum so procurement can finalize.

—Alex
